# QueryDrop

> Free, private, browser-based tools for converting and querying data files (CSV, Parquet, Excel, JSON, GeoJSON, and more). All processing happens locally on the user's device — files are never uploaded. No accounts, no signup, no cost.

## Converters

- [Parquet to CSV](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/parquet-to-csv/): Convert .parquet files to .csv in the browser, no upload.
- [CSV to Parquet](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/csv-to-parquet/): Convert .csv files to compressed, columnar .parquet.
- [Excel to CSV](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/excel-to-csv/): Convert .xlsx/.xls workbooks to .csv (first sheet).
- [CSV to JSON](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/csv-to-json/): Convert .csv rows to a JSON array of objects.
- [JSON to CSV](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/json-to-csv/): Convert JSON / NDJSON to .csv.
- [CSV to SQLite](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/csv-to-sqlite/): Build a queryable .sqlite3 database from a .csv.
- [Parquet to Excel](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/parquet-to-excel/): Convert .parquet to an .xlsx workbook.
- [Parquet to JSON](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/parquet-to-json/): Convert .parquet to a JSON array of objects.
- [Excel to Parquet](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/excel-to-parquet/): Convert .xlsx to columnar .parquet.
- [GeoJSON to CSV](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/geojson-to-csv/): Convert GeoJSON features to .csv rows.
- [All conversions](https://querydrop.pages.dev/convert/): The full converter hub (9 input formats × 9 output formats).

## Tools

- [SQL Query Pad](https://querydrop.pages.dev/tool/): Run real DuckDB SQL on local files — joins, aggregations, window functions, pivots. No upload, results exportable to 9 formats.
- [Online Pivot Table](https://querydrop.pages.dev/pivot/): Build pivot tables from local files in the browser.
